patch.description:
Partial JSON merge-patch. Examples: `{ "labor_factor": 1.15 }`, `{ "tax": { "labor": 8.25 } }`, `{ "margin": { "material": 12 } }`.
margin is stored as margin, not markup. Convert markup with margin = 100 * markup / (100 + markup) (25% markup = 20% margin).
markups is read-only on this resource; create, update, or delete markups via the dedicated markup endpoints.

parameters.description: Unique company identifier associated with the Procore User Account.

requestBody.description: Fields to update. Only provided fields are written; omitted fields stay unchanged. Nested objects (`waste`, `margin`, `tax`) merge per category.

schema.description:
Partial Estimate Summary update. Only properties with a specified
Optional`1 value are written; omitted fields stay unchanged.
Nested objects merge per cost category.

waste.description: Waste percentages by cost category. Only provided categories are updated.

margin.description:
Profit percentages by cost category. Only provided categories are updated.
Values are stored as margin (not markup). Company margin locks are honored by the server.
To convert a markup percentage to margin: margin = 100 * markup / (100 + markup).
Example: send 20 to store a 25% markup.

tax.description: Tax percentages by cost category. Only provided categories are updated.

post.summary: Create a markup on a proposal
post.description:
Returns 201 with the created markup.
An ITERATIVE markup always compounds all preceding markups; compound_all is set implicitly and
compound_with is not allowed. Only one ITERATIVE markup can exist per proposal, and it must be POST_TAX.
LEGACY_OVERHEAD and LEGACY_DISCOUNT must be PRE_TAX; creating one re-enables and updates the existing
disabled legacy markup when present. Creating a LEGACY_OVERHEAD sets an existing LEGACY_DISCOUNT's
compound_with to the overhead, and vice versa. Only markups from the same stage, except
ITERATIVE, can be referenced in compound_with.
